description:
Write odoo.conf + the nginx site (rendered from the plan), enable nginx and
    restart Odoo. Uses the SAME renderers as the 1a preview, so no drift. The Odoo
    master password (admin_passwd) is loaded from `secrets_path` (secrets.json) on
    apply - a blank field there is auto-generated and written back. The password
    itself is NEVER returned; only which file holds it.
name: config_apply
